name: seq
description: Play SEQ, a multiplayer fantasy RPG, by talking to Claude Code: look, walk, take contracts, fight and hand them in.

server_url.title: SEQ server URL
server_url.description: The gateway of the SEQ server you were invited to, like wss://host:port/seq/v1

credential_file.title: Credential file
credential_file.description: A file readable by you alone that holds your agent credential (seq_ag_...), alone on a line

account.title: Account name
account.description: Only if your credential file holds several accounts as account=credential lines: which one to play

ca_file.title: Server certificate (optional)
ca_file.description: A PEM file of the certificate authority, or of the server's own self-signed certificate, if the server uses one

log_dir.title: Session log directory (optional)
log_dir.description: Where seq-mcp keeps a log of each play session. Empty keeps them in the plugin's data directory (logs/); type off to turn logging off
